metadata.title: Checklist for Validating Capacitor App Updates
metadata.description: Ensure smooth app updates with this actionable checklist for validating over-the-air updates and choosing the right tools.
metadata.author: Martin Donadieu
metadata.head_image_alt: Checklist for Validating Capacitor App Updates Capgo blog illustration
metadata.keywords: Capacitor, app updates, OTA updates, testing checklist, mobile development

blocks.text: Here’s a quick, actionable checklist for validating
app updates, especially when using over-the-air (OTA) updates:
: Ensure all workflows (like login, data sync) function end-to-end.
: Test on various devices, operating systems, and screen sizes.
: Measure speed, responsiveness, and memory usage under different conditions.
: Encrypt OTA updates, assign permissions, and test rollback features.
to ensure 95% of users get updates within 24 hours.
: Track success rates (aim for 82%), API response times, and user engagement.
Follow this checklist and choose the right tools to ensure every update is fast, secure, and reliable.

After completing the main testing phase, focus on validation, documentation, staged rollouts, and ongoing monitoring.

Once the primary tests are done, document the results using your analytics platform. Leverage the dashboard you set up during the Pre-Validation phase to track key metrics through Capgo's analytics tools.
Make sure to log any errors and their resolutions to streamline future updates.
Introduce updates gradually using beta channels
: Start with a small group of internal testers.
: Broaden the beta to include larger groups.
: Keep an eye on metrics and gather user feedback.
: Address any problems before the full release.
Ensure beta builds are tested on critical devices to avoid compatibility issues during the official launch.
"Analytics and error tracking" are important for updates. – Capgo
Keep track of these critical metrics after deployment:
: Aim for at least 82% (via Capgo Analytics).
: Ensure 95% coverage within 24 hours (using Real-time Tracking).
: Maintain responses at or below 434 ms (via Performance Monitor).
Set up alerts to notify your team if any metrics fall below these thresholds.

Using a combination of thorough testing, staged rollouts, and rollback controls is crucial for delivering smooth user experiences. With these practices and insights from our OTA tools comparison, you’ll be well-prepared to deploy updates with confidence.
A strong validation strategy includes systematic testing, real-time monitoring, rollback options, and staged beta releases to ensure quality. As one user shared:
"Capgo is a must-have tool for developers who want to be more productive; avoiding app-store review for bug fixes is golden."

For teams working with OTA updates, finding the right balance between fast deployment and careful validation is essential. With proper testing in place, developers can release updates that meet the high standards users expect. Keep this checklist handy to maintain reliability and user trust with every release.
